remarks: Best Value in Wilton! Featured in Fairfield County Home magazine, entitled "English Style," this little beauty was built by a retired Sea Captain in 1850 while the railroad was being built and was a popular Inn and Tavern.This multi-structure, 2.5 acre property is packed with Connecticut character! In addition to the pristine 3 bedroom Classic home, there is an oversized detached two car garage and a carriage house! Within the home there are lots of spacious rooms with gorgeous details and fun nooks and crannies making this a very special place to call home. The high-end kitchen is equipped w/custom white cabinetry, stone countertops, sub zero refrigerator/freezer/icemaker, GE Profile Gas Range and ergonomically-correct two-drawer Fisher Paykel dishwasher. There is a receiving room with radiant heat floors, (so welcoming on a winter's day), a music room/office, a true formal dining room, formal living room with fireplace, large sunny double home office/gym, a delightful "sea blue" walk-in pantry/bar. There are 3 bedrooms, 2 with with cathedral ceilings! Many major upgrades; Brand new On-Demand tankless hot water system, New electric panel 2019, New Central AC 2019, New engineered septic system in 2010 and huge air-jet tub. The yard has invisible dog fencing plus 2 fenced areas, safe for pooches or play and the property rambles beyond into your own private woods! This tasteful gem is in a convenient commuter location, only 50 miles to NYC! Many additional photos coming
